events.description: The ACL create event triggers every time you create an ACL.
The ACL delete event triggers every time you delete an ACL.
The ACL update event triggers every time you update an ACL.
The Calendar list create event triggers every time you add a calendar to your calendarlist.
The Calendar list delete event triggers every time you remove a calendar from your calendar list.
The Calendar list update event triggers every time you update a calendar in your calendar list.
The Event create event triggers every time you create an event in your calendar.
The Event delete event triggers every time you remove an event in your calendar.
The Event update event triggers every time you update an event in your calendar.
The Setting create event triggers every time you create a setting of your calendar.
The Setting update event triggers every time you update a setting of your calendar.
The File edited event is triggered when a file is edited in your account.
The Chat Channel Created event is triggered when a user creates a chat channel.
The Chat Channel Deleted event is triggered when a chat channel administrator deletes the channel.
The Member Invited event is triggered when a user is invited to a chat channel.
The Member Joined event is triggered when a user manually joins a public chat channel or joins via the Join a Channel API.
The Member Left event is triggered when a user leaves a chat channel.
The Member Removed event is triggered when a chat channel member removes a user from the channel.
The Chat Channel Updated event is triggered when a chat channel administrator updates a channel's information.
The Chat Message Deleted event is triggered when a user deletes a chat message that was previously sent to a contact or a chat channel.
The Chat Message Replied event is triggered when a user replies to a chat message in a thread.
The Chat Message Sent event is triggered when a user sends a chat message to a contact or a chat channel.
The Chat Message Updated event is triggered when a user updates a message that was previously sent to a contact or a chat channel.
The Data Table Row Created event is triggered every time a new data table row is created for your account.
The Data Table Row Updated event is triggered every time a data table row is updated for your account.
The Data Table User Mentioned event is triggered every time when new users are mentioned for your account.
The File created event is triggered every time a docs file is created for your account.
The Mail History Event triggers whenever there is message related change in the mailbox.
The AI Companion assets deleted event is triggered when all AI Companion meeting assets, such as transcripts and summaries, are deleted during a live meeting.
The AI Companion started event is triggered when a user starts the AI Companion during a live meeting.
The AI Companion stopped event is triggered when a user stops the AI Companion during a live meeting.
The AIC transcript completed triggers when the meeting transcript file is completed after a meeting or webinar ends.
The Meeting issues alert event is triggered every time a service issue is encountered during a meeting scheduled by a user in your account or in accounts that have installed your webhook-enabled app.
The User in breakout room stopped sharing event is triggered when a user in a breakout room ends their content-sharing, such as their desktop or the classic whiteboard.
The User in breakout room started sharing event is triggered when a user in a breakout room begins sharing content, such as their desktop or the classic whiteboard.
The In-meeting chat message file has been downloaded event is triggered when a meeting's message file is downloaded.
The In-meeting chat message file received event is triggered when a meeting's message file is available to view or download.
The In-meeting chat message received event is triggered when a user sends a public or private chat message during a meeting using the in-meeting Zoom chat feature.
The Meeting has been converted to a Webinar event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users converts a meeting into a webinar.
The Meeting has been created event is triggered every time a meeting is created by one of your app users or account users.
The Meeting has been deleted event is triggered every time a meeting scheduled by one of your app users or account users, is deleted.
The Meeting Device Tested event is triggered every time a user completes a connected device test.
The End Meeting event is triggered every time a meeting host ends the meeting.
The Invited party answered a meeting invitation event is triggered every time an invitation's recipient accepts an invitation to join a meeting or video call.
The Invited party's Zoom is ringing event is triggered every time a user sends an invitation to join a meeting or video call to one or more recipients.
The Invited party rejected a meeting invite event is triggered every time a user sends an invitation to join a meeting or video call to one or more recipients.
The Invited party missed a meeting invitation event is triggered every time an invitation to join a meeting or video call to one or more recipients times out.
The Meeting Live Streaming Started event is triggered every time a meeting's live stream begins on a streaming platform.
The Meeting Live Streaming Stopped event is triggered every time a meeting's live stream ends.
The Participant was admitted into a meeting event is triggered every time a meeting host admits the participant from a waiting room to the meeting.
The Phone User Bind To Participant event is triggered every time a phone user joins a meeting and binds to an attendee in the meeting.
The Participant or Host connection established event is triggered every time an attendee establishes a data connection when joining a meeting.
The Get participant survey feedback for meetings event is triggered every time an attendee completes an end-of-meeting experience feedback survey for a meeting.
The Participant joined meeting before host event is triggered every time an attendee joins a meeting before the host.
The Participant waiting for host to join event is triggered every time an attendee has been waiting for the host to join the meeting for at least 30 seconds.
The Waiting participant left meeting before host joined event is triggered every time an attendee waiting for the host to join the meeting leaves before the host.
The Participant or Host joined meeting event is triggered every time an attendee joins a meeting.
The Meeting participant has joined a breakout room event is triggered when a meeting participant joins a meeting breakout room.
The Participant joined a waiting room event is triggered every time an attendee joins a waiting room prior to being admitted to the meeting.
The Participant/Host left meeting event is triggered every time an attendee leaves a meeting.
The Meeting participant has left a breakout room event is triggered when a meeting participant leaves a meeting breakout room.
The Participant left a waiting room event is triggered every time a meeting host does not admit a participant to the meeting and removes the participant from the waiting room.
The Invited party answered a meeting invitation through phone (call out) event is triggered every time a user accepts an invitation to join a meeting through phone (call out).
The meeting invitation through phone (call out) failed event is triggered every time an invitation to join a meeting through phone (call out) failed.
The Invited party missed a meeting invitation through phone (call out) event is triggered every time an invitation to join a meeting through phone (call out) times out.
The Invited party rejected a meeting invitation through phone (call out) event is triggered every time a user rejects an invitation to join a meeting through phone (call out).
The Invited party's phone (call out) ringing event is triggered every time a user's phone rings when they are invited to join a meeting through phone (call out).
The Participant was put in a waiting room event is triggered every time a participant who has already joined the meeting is returned to the waiting room during the meeting.
The Participant role changed event is triggered every time a host or meeting attendee changes their role during the meeting.
The Invited party answered a meeting invitation through phone (call out) via Zoom room event is triggered every time a user joins a meeting through phone (call out) from a Zoom room.
The Meeting invitation through phone (call out) via Zoom room failed event is triggered every time an invitation to join a meeting through phone (call out) from a Zoom room fails.
The Invited party missed a meeting invitation through phone (call out) via Zoom room event is triggered every time an invitation to join a meeting through phone (call out) from a Zoom room times out.

The Invited party rejected a meeting invitation through phone (call out) via Zoom room event is triggered every time a user rejects an invitation to join a meeting through phone (call out) from a Zoom room.
The Invited party's phone (call out) ringing in Zoom room event is triggered every time a user's phone is ringing when they were invited to join a meeting through phone (call out) from a Zoom room.
The Meeting has been permanently deleted event is triggered every time a meeting scheduled by one of your app users or account users, is permanently deleted.
The Meeting has been recovered event is triggered every time a user recovers a previously-deleted meeting.
The Meeting Registration has been approved event is triggered every time a registrant is approved for the meeting.
The Meeting Registration has been canceled event is triggered every time a registration is canceled for a meeting.
The Meeting Registration has been created event is triggered every time a user registers for a meeting.
The Meeting Registration has been denied event is triggered every time a registrant is denied from participating in a meeting.
The At-Risk Meeting Notifier event is triggered every time someone posts a Zoom meeting link to a social media account, such as Reddit or Twitter.
The Meeting Sharing Ended event is triggered every time an attendee or a host stops sharing their screen during a Zoom meeting.
The Meeting Sharing Started event is triggered every time an attendee or a host begins sharing their screen during a Zoom meeting.
The Start Meeting event is triggered every time a meeting host starts a meeting.
The Meeting summary has been completed event is triggered every time the summary of the meeting is made available for one of your app users or account users after the summarized meeting/webinar ends.
The Meeting summary has been permanently deleted event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users permanently deletes a meeting summary.
The Meeting summary has been recovered from trash event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users recovers a summary from the trash.
The Meeting summary has been shared event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users shares a meeting summary.
The Meeting summary has been deleted to trash event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users temporarily deletes a meeting summary.
The Meeting summary has been updated event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users updates a meeting summary.
The Meeting has been updated event is triggered when a meeting scheduled by one of your app users or account users is updated.
The Note completed event is triggered when a note is completed.
The Note generated event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users generate note.
The Transcript generated event is triggered when a note transcript is generated.
The Opt-in-status event received by Zoom phone triggers when an account user receives an SMS message with text of an opt-in keyword, such as START.
The SMS Opt-out event from Zoom phone triggers when an account user receives an SMS message with text of an opt-out keyword, such as STOP.
The SMS etiquette block event from Zoom phone triggers when an account user's outbound text violates a SMS etiquette block policy defined in the Zoom phone web admin portal.
The SMS etiquette warn event from Zoom phone triggers when an account user's outbound text violates a SMS etiquette warn policy defined in Zoom phone web admin portal.
Zoom triggers this event after the Quality Management user evaluation is completed.
Zoom triggers this event after the Quality Management users interaction analysis is completed.
The Recording Archive Files Completed event is triggered every time the archived files of a meeting or webinar become available to download.
The Batch recording deleted event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users permanently deletes one or more cloud recordings.
The Batch recording recovered event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users recover one or more recordings from the trash.
The All recording files have been deleted to the Trash event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users temporarily delete all of their cloud recordings.
The Recording Cloud Storage Usage Updated event is triggered every time storage usage changes.
This event is triggered when a recording of a meeting or webinar becomes available to view or download.
This event is triggered when a user permanently deletes a cloud recording.
The Recording Paused event is triggered every time a recording is paused by one of your app's users or account users.
This event is triggered when a user recovers a recording from the trash.
The View registrant has approved for this recording event is triggered every time a registrant is approved to view a cloud recording.
The View registrant has registered for this recording event is triggered every time a user registers for an on-demand cloud recording.
The View registrant has denied for this recording event is triggered every time a registrant is denied from viewing a cloud recording.
The Recording Renamed event is triggered every time the title of a cloud recording is changed.
The Recording Resumed event is triggered every time a previously paused recording of a meeting or webinar is resumed.
The Recording Started event is triggered every time a recording is started by one of your app users or account users.
The Recording Stopped event is triggered every time a recording is stopped by one of your app's users or account users.

The Recording transcript files have completed event is triggered every time the transcript of the recording is made available for one of your app users or account users after the recorded meeting/webinar ends.
This event is triggered when a user initially deletes a cloud recording.
Zoom triggers this event after the ZRA users conversation analysis is completed.
This event is triggered when the ZRA conversation associations with CRM objects are changed.
Zoom triggers this event when a ZRA user adds a moment to a playlist.
Zoom triggers this event when a ZRA user creates a playlist.
Zoom triggers this event when a ZRA user deletes a playlist.
Zoom triggers this event when a ZRA user removes a moment from a playlist.
Zoom triggers this event after a ZRA user comments on a conversation.
The Routing form submission created event is triggered when a user successfully submits a Routing Form.
The Scheduled event canceled event triggers each time the host or booker cancels the scheduled event.
The Scheduled event created event triggers each time one user schedules an event with the scheduler host through the public booking page.
The Task assignee were updated event is triggered every time a task assignee is added or deleted to share a task with a Zoom user
The Task collaborator were updated event is triggered every time a task collaborator is added or deleted to share a task with a Zoom user
The Task comment was updated event is triggered every time a task comment is updated to task.
The task was completed event is triggered every time a task status is done.
The Task was created event is triggered every time a task is created by one of your app users or account users.
The Task deleted event is triggered every time a task is delete by one of your app users or account users.
The task was reopened event is triggered every time a task is opened.
The Task was updated event is triggered every time a task is updated.
The Message bookmark added event triggers when user bookmarks a message.
The Message bookmark removed event triggers when user removes a bookmark to a message.
The Team Chat channel app added event triggers when some chat bot apps are added to a chat channel
The Team Chat channel app removed event triggers when a chat bot app is removed from a chat channel.
The Chat channel archived event triggers when a chat channel owner archives the channel.
The Team Chat channel invitation accepted event triggers when a user accepted the chat channel invitation which previously sent to him .

The Team Chat channel invitation approval requested event triggers when the channel account or invitee account enables the Require admin approval for inviting external users in group chats and channels option and it needs them to approve th
The Team Chat channel invitation approved event triggers when the inviation is approved.
The Team Chat channel invitation created event triggers when a user is invited into a team chat channel.
The Team Chat channel invitation declined event triggers when the inviation is declined.
The Team Chat channel invitation rejected event triggers when a user rejects the chat channel invitation that was previously sent.
The Team Chat channel invitation removed event triggers when an inviter removed the chat channel invitation which previously he created.

The Team Chat channel join approval requested event triggers when the channel account or requester account enable the Require admin approval for inviting external users in group chats and channels option and it needs them to approve the inv
The Team Chat Channel Join Approved event triggers when the join request is approved.
The Team Chat channel join declined event triggers when the join request is declined.
The Team Chat channel join requested event triggers when a user requested to join into a team chat channel.
This event triggers when a message is deleted in a chat channel.
The Team Chat channel message posted event triggers when a chat channel receives a message.
The Team Chat channel message updated event triggers when a chat channel message updates.
The Message pinned event triggers when a pin is added to a chat channel.
The Message unpinned event triggers when a pin is removed from a chat channel.

The Team Chat channel reaction added event triggers when a user adds a reaction under a chat message of a channel and the event is sent to all channel members who can see the content that was reacted to.

The Team Chat channel reaction removed event triggers when a user removes a reaction under a chat message of a channel and the event is sent to all channel members who can see the content that was reacted to.
The Chat channel unarchived event triggers when a chat channel owner unarchives the channel.
The Team Chat DM message deleted event triggers when a message is deleted in a DM chat.
The Team Chat DM message posted event triggers when a message is received in a DM chat.
The Team Chat DM message updated event triggers when a direct message (DM) chat message is updated.
The Team Chat direct reaction added event triggers when a user sends a reaction under a chat message of a contact and the app is installed for the message receiver user.
The Team Chat direct reaction removed event triggers when a user removes a reaction under a chat message of a contact and the app is installed for the message receiver user.
The Custom emoji added event is triggered when a user adds a custom emoji.
The Custom emoji removed event is triggered when a user removes a custom emoji.
This event is triggered when a user changes files in Team Chat.
This event is triggered when a user deletes files in Team Chat.
The Team Chat file downloaded event triggers when a user downloads a file sent in the IM chat.
The Team chat file shared event triggers when a user shares files with a contact or a channel in Team Chat.
The Team chat file unshared event triggers when a user unshares files with a contact or a channel in Team Chat.
This event is triggered when a user uploads files in Team Chat.
The Space has been edited event triggers the settings of shared space changes.
The Member has been invited event triggers when a contact is invited to a shared space.
The Member has left space  event triggers when a member has left a shared space.
The Member has been removed event triggers when a member removes other users from a shared space.
The Session starred event triggers when user stars some contacts and channels.
The Session unstarred event triggers when user unstars some contacts and channels.
The User has been activated event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users activates a deactivated user.
The User has been created event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users adds another user to the account.
The User has been deactivated event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users gets deactivated.
The User has been deleted event is triggered when an admin or account owner deletes a user from a Zoom account.
The User has been disassociated event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users is unlinked from an account.
The User has accepted the account invitation event is triggered every time a user accepts the invitation to join a Zoom account.
The User's personal notes have been updated event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users updates personal notes on the Zoom Client app.
The User's presence status has been updated event triggers whenever a user's presence status changes in the Zoom Client app.
Zoom triggers this event when a user updates the settings of your app users or account.
The User has signed in event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users signs in to Zoom.
The User has signed out event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users signs out of Zoom.
The A user's TSP account was created event is triggered every time a TSP user account is created in Zoom.
The A user's TSP account was deleted event is triggered every time a TSP user account is deleted.
The A user's TSP account was updated event is triggered every time a user's TSP account information is updated.
The User's profile info has been updated event is triggered every time the profile of one of your app users or account users is updated.
The Channel Deleted event is triggered when a video channel has been deleted.
The Channel Owner Changed event is triggered when a channel owner is changed.
The Channel Published event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, publishes a video channel.
The Channel unpublished event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app unpublishes a video channel
The channel video added event is triggered every time a user in your account, or your app, adds a video to a channel.
The channel video removed event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, removed a video from a channel.
The Quiz Completed event is triggered every time a user completes the video quiz.
The Webinar issues alert event is triggered every time a Webinar hosted by one of your app users or account users, encounters a service issue.
The In-webinar chat message file has been downloaded event is triggered when a message file from a webinar is downloaded.
The In-webinar chat message file received event is triggered when a message file of a webinar is available to view or download.
The In-webinar chat message received event is triggered when a user sends a public or private chat message during a webinar using the chat feature.
The Webinar has been converted to a Meeting event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users converts a webinar into a meeting.
Zoom triggers this event every time one of your app users or account users creates a Webinar.
The Webinar has been deleted event is triggered every time a webinar scheduled by one of your app users or account users, is deleted.
The End Webinar event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app ends a webinar.
descriptionThe Phone User Bind To Participant event is triggered every time a phone user joins a webinar and binds to an attendee in the webinar.
The Participant or Host connection established event is triggered when an attendee establishes a data connection when joining a webinar.
The Get participant survey feedback for webinars event is triggered every time an attendee completes an end-of-webinar feedback survey for a webinar.
The Participant/Host joined webinar event is triggered every time a host or an attendee joins a webinar that was created by one of your app users or account users.
The Participant/Host left webinar event is triggered every time a host of a webinar or an attendee leaves the webinar.
The Participant role changed event is triggered every time a host or webinar attendee changes the role during a webinar created by one of your app users or account users.
The Webinar has been permanently deleted event is triggered every time a scheduled webinar is permanently deleted.
The Webinar has been recovered event is triggered every time a user recovers a previously-deleted webinar.
The Webinar Registration has been approved event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users approve a user's registration.
The Webinar Registration has been canceled event is triggered whenever one of these two conditions are met:
The Webinar Registration has been created event is triggered every time someone registers for a Webinar created by one of your app users or account users.
The Webinar Registration has been denied event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users denies a user's registration.
The Webinar Sharing Ended event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users stop sharing their screen during a Webinar.
The Webinar Sharing Started event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users share their screen during a Webinar.
The Start Webinar event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app starts a webinar.
The Webinar has been updated event is triggered every time one of your app users or account users updates a webinar.
The Whiteboard archive was available event is emitted whenever a whiteboard archived sessions is successfully generated.
The Whiteboard was created event is triggered every time a whiteboard is created by one of your app users or account users.
The Whiteboard deleted event is triggered every time a whiteboard is delete by one of your app users or account users.
The Whiteboard file was added  event is triggered when a file is successfully added to a whiteboard.
The Whiteboard was opened event is triggered every time a whiteboard is opened.
Whiteboard share settings can be updated by a whiteboard owner or co-owners.
The Whiteboard was shared event is triggered every time a whiteboard is shared with a Zoom user or a team chat channel by one of your whiteboard collaborators.
The Whiteboard collaborator's sharing settings were updated event is triggered every time the of a whiteboard collaborator is updated or removed by one of your whiteboard owners.
The Event Cancelled event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, cancels the event in Zoom Events.
The Event Duplicated is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, duplicates an existing event in Zoom Events.
The Event Published event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, publishes an event in Zoom Events.
The Event Updated is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, makes changes to the event data in Zoom Events.
The Exhibitor Created  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app creates exhibitor for an event in Zoom Events.
The Exhibitor Deleted  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app deletes exhibitor for an event in Zoom Events.
The Exhibitor Updated  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app updates exhibitor for an event in Zoom Events.
The Session Created event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, creates a session in Zoom Events.
The Session Deleted event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, deletes a session in Zoom Events.
The End Session event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app ends a zoom-events session.
The Session Updated event is triggered every time a user in your account or your app, updates a session in Zoom Events.
The Speaker Created  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app creates speaker for an event in Zoom Events.
The Speaker Deleted  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app deletes speaker for an event in Zoom Events.
The Speaker Updated  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app updates speaker for an event in Zoom Events.
The Ticket Created  event  is triggered when someone registers for an event created by one of your app users or account users.
The  Ticket Deleted  event is triggered when one of your app users or account users cancels the event registration.
The TicketType Created  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app creates ticketType for an event in Zoom Events.
The TicketType Deleted  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app deletes ticketType for an event in Zoom Events.
The TicketType Updated  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app updates ticketType for an event in Zoom Events.
The Ticket Updated  event  is triggered every time a user in your account or your app updates the attendee registration information in Zoom Events.
The VOD Registration Created  event  is triggered when someone registers for a video on-demand(VOD) channel  created by one of your app users or account users.
